title: AnswerResult
description: Frozen at M0 from contracts/result-schemas.md (PRD §7.3). Return shape of ask() — RetrievalResult plus answer/status/reason/citations.

answer.description: Null is valid and expected for status=insufficient_evidence. Never invented content when evidence is missing (INV-04).

status.description: Distinct from RetrievalResult.status (ok|empty|partial) — this is the answer-specific outcome.

evidence_id.description: MUST reference an evidence_id present in this same response's evidence[] — never across a Snapshot boundary (INV-05).
